author: /root/rig_identity
status: Fifteen evidence-only successors and qualified integration plan prepared in this stage; publication, source and old verifiers remain untouched.

crosswalk.qualification: The helper pins the crosswalk file, checks original historical transport SHA/length/Git blob, and separately checks reconstructed public SHA/length/Git blob. Historical original and public reconstructed bytes differ. Public verification cannot prove the private redaction operation.

script_preservation.proof: The deterministic generator checks every original hash and inverts each targeted edit to exactly the original bytes. The independently rebuilt scripts and source map are byte-identical. Each changed assertion remains an assertion and every other original statement is retained.
script_preservation.qualification: The helper adds a qualified identity map only for the exact two historical paths; non-target reads and byte assertions remain strict.

verification.qualification: The final helper version pins its config SHA and uses a precise path-check count. The prior v1 run is retained for chronology. Evidence checks were read-only, with publication and public reconstruction as separate directories; no old verifier, full evidence driver or product ran.

negative_read_only_evidence_check: verification/NEGATIVE-ORIGINAL-REJECTION.json records that the unchanged original top-level bytes are rejected when presented as the public reconstruction.

semantic_pointers.qualification: Original private versus public reconstructed subtrees were structurally compared. Each literal pointer still resolves and only its listed 8 or 4 local-path values become privacy markers. Canonical subtree hashes in that analysis are fresh serializations; dynamic references and path usability remain open.

limits: The full evidence driver and other semantic readers have not been run; no lens or historical record was closed.
No product execution, source builds, product tests, runtime probes, repair, publication edit, user-extraction modification, symlink following or Git history modification.
Original historical 059 identities remain attributed to that recovered checkpoint, never checkpoint3821.
